---
# Static, serverless prototype of the Shiny app in the repository root.
# The page title is set in _quarto.yml (pagetitle) so none shows on the page.
# Data comes from data/*.json, written by prep_static_data.R.
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false

// Data -------------------------------------------------------------------

districtRows = FileAttachment("data/districts.json").json()
legislators = FileAttachment("data/legislators.json").json()
voterTypeText = FileAttachment("data/voter_type_text.json").json()
boundaries = FileAttachment("data/house_districts.geojson").json()
turf = require("@turf/turf@7.2.0")

// Address lookup -----------------------------------------------------------

// Rough box around Iowa, so geocoders prefer Iowa matches
iowaBox = ({xmin: -96.7, ymin: 40.3, xmax: -90.1, ymax: 43.6})

// Esri result types precise enough to place a home in a district. City, ZIP
// and county matches are rejected: their center could be in any district.
esriPreciseTypes = new Set([
  "PointAddress", "Subaddress", "StreetAddress", "StreetAddressExt",
  "StreetInt", "StreetMidBlock", "StreetBetween", "POI"
])

// Turn an address into [longitude, latitude], or null if it can't be found
// precisely. Esri first, OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) if Esri can't be reached
// or finds nothing. Both are called straight from the browser; the address
// isn't sent anywhere else.
async function geocode(address) {
  const query = /\b(ia|iowa)\b/i.test(address) ? address : `${address}, Iowa`;

  try {
    const url = new URL("https://geocode.arcgis.com/arcgis/rest/services/World/GeocodeServer/findAddressCandidates");
    url.search = new URLSearchParams({
      SingleLine: query, f: "json", maxLocations: 1, countryCode: "USA",
      outFields: "Addr_type",
      searchExtent: [iowaBox.xmin, iowaBox.ymin, iowaBox.xmax, iowaBox.ymax].join(",")
    });
    const result = (await (await fetch(url)).json()).candidates?.[0];
    if (result && esriPreciseTypes.has(result.attributes.Addr_type)) {
      return [result.location.x, result.location.y];
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("Esri geocoder failed, trying OpenStreetMap", error);
  }

  try {
    const url = new URL("https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search");
    url.search = new URLSearchParams({
      q: query, format: "jsonv2", limit: 1, countrycodes: "us",
      viewbox: [iowaBox.xmin, iowaBox.ymax, iowaBox.xmax, iowaBox.ymin].join(","),
      bounded: 1
    });
    const result = (await (await fetch(url)).json())[0];
    // place_rank 26+ is a street or more precise
    if (result && result.place_rank >= 26) return [+result.lon, +result.lat];
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn("OpenStreetMap geocoder failed", error);
  }

  return null;
}

// The House district a point falls in, or null outside Iowa. The boundaries
// are simplified, which opens thin slivers along district lines; a point in
// one goes to the nearest district within 50 m.
function findDistrict(lonLat) {
  const point = turf.point(lonLat);
  const hit = boundaries.features.find(f => turf.booleanPointInPolygon(point, f));
  if (hit) return hit.properties.district_num;

  let nearest = null, nearestDistance = Infinity;
  for (const f of boundaries.features) {
    const distance = Math.abs(turf.pointToPolygonDistance(point, f, {units: "meters"}));
    if (distance < nearestDistance) [nearest, nearestDistance] = [f, distance];
  }
  return nearestDistance <= 50 ? nearest.properties.district_num : null;
}

// Labels and lookups --------------------------------------------------------

partyChoices = [
  ["No Party", "No Party"], ["Republican", "Rep"], ["Democratic", "Dem"],
  ["Libertarian", "Lib"], ["Other", "Other"]
]

// Friendly URL values for ?party= onto the party values
partyLookup = ({
  rep: "Rep", republican: "Rep",
  dem: "Dem", democrat: "Dem", democratic: "Dem",
  lib: "Lib", libertarian: "Lib",
  other: "Other",
  none: "No Party", np: "No Party", "no party": "No Party", noparty: "No Party"
})

partyNames = ({Rep: "Republican", Dem: "Democrat", Lib: "Libertarian", "No Party": "No party", Other: "Other party"})
partyPrimaryNames = ({Rep: "Republican", Dem: "Democratic"})
voterGroupNames = ({Lib: "Libertarian voters", "No Party": "no-party voters", Other: "other-party voters"})

// Matches the Shiny app's percent(): one decimal, trailing zero dropped
percent = x => `${+(x * 100).toFixed(1)}%`

legislatorLabel = district => {
  const legislator = legislators.find(l => l.district_num === district);
  return legislator ? `${legislator.name} (${district})` : null;
}

// Small line icons, standing in for the Shiny app's Font Awesome icons
icon = {
  const paths = {
    check: "M3 8.5l3.5 3.5L13 4.5",
    xmark: "M4 4l8 8M12 4l-8 8",
    "arrow-down": "M8 2v12M3 9l5 5 5-5",
    "arrow-left": "M14 8H2M7 3L2 8l5 5",
    search: "M11 11l4 4M12 7A5 5 0 1 1 2 7a5 5 0 0 1 10 0z",
    "circle-check": "M15 8A7 7 0 1 1 1 8a7 7 0 0 1 14 0zM5 8.2l2 2 4-4"
  };
  return name => htl.svg`<svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true">
    <path d="${paths[name]}"></path></svg>`;
}

// Results pieces (ported from server.R) ---------------------------------

// General election margin dial, from "Close race" to "Foregone conclusion".
// The four zones match the margin categories rather than a linear 0-100%
// scale, since half of all margins are over 35%. Uncontested races pin the
// needle at the very end.
dialZones = [
  {label: "Close race", from: 0, to: 0.05, color: "#3C3489"},
  {label: "Competitive", from: 0.05, to: 0.10, color: "#7F77DD"},
  {label: "Leaning", from: 0.10, to: 0.20, color: "#B4B2A9"},
  {label: "Foregone conclusion", from: 0.20, to: 0.60, color: "#5F5E5A"}
]

dialZoneIndex = margin => dialZones.findLastIndex(z => margin >= z.from)

function marginDial(margin, uncontested) {
  const cx = 150, cy = 160, r = 110, n = dialZones.length;
  const point = (position, radius = r) => {
    const angle = Math.PI * (1 - position);
    return [cx + radius * Math.cos(angle), cy - radius * Math.sin(angle)];
  };
  let position = 1;
  if (!uncontested) {
    const zone = dialZoneIndex(margin), z = dialZones[zone];
    const within = (margin - z.from) / (z.to - z.from);
    // Contested races stop just short of the end, kept for uncontested ones
    position = Math.min((zone + Math.min(within, 1)) / n, 0.97);
  }
  const needle = point(position, 88);
  const zoneLabel = uncontested ? "Uncontested" : dialZones[dialZoneIndex(margin)].label;
  const value = uncontested ? "No opponent" : percent(margin);

  const arcs = dialZones.map((z, i) => {
    const [ax, ay] = point(i / n), [bx, by] = point((i + 1) / n);
    return htl.svg`<path d=${`M${ax} ${ay} A${r} ${r} 0 0 1 ${bx} ${by}`}
      stroke=${z.color} stroke-width="22" fill="none"></path>`;
  });

  return htl.html`<div class="margin-dial">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 300 200" role="img" aria-label=${`General election margin: ${value}, ${zoneLabel}`}>
      ${arcs}
      <line x1="150" y1="28" x2="150" y2="74" class="dial-threshold"/>
      <text x="150" y="20" text-anchor="middle" class="dial-threshold-label">10% competitive line</text>
      <line x1=${cx} y1=${cy} x2=${needle[0]} y2=${needle[1]} class="dial-needle"/>
      <circle cx=${cx} cy=${cy} r="7" class="dial-hub"/>
      <text x="20" y="194" class="dial-end-label">Close race</text>
      <text x="280" y="194" text-anchor="end" class="dial-end-label">Foregone conclusion</text>
    </svg>
    <div class="dial-value">${value}</div>
    <div class="dial-zone">${zoneLabel}</div>
  </div>`;
}

// The voter's two chances to make a difference, the primary and then the
// general election, each with whether it gave them a meaningful vote
function primaryStep(d) {
  const winnerPrimary = partyPrimaryNames[d.gen_winning_party];
  const contested = !["No Primary", "Uncontested"].includes(d.prim_margin_description);
  const noChoice = {pass: false, title: "No primary choice", detail: "No one ran against your party's candidate."};
  switch (d.voter_classification) {
    case "Meaningful (General)":
    case "Meaningful (Primary)":
      if (contested) return {pass: true, title: "You had more than one choice",
        detail: `Your party's primary was contested, decided by ${d.prim_margin_description}.`};
      if (d.prim_margin_description === "No Primary") return {pass: false, title: "No primary choice",
        detail: "No one ran in your party's primary."};
      return noChoice;
    case "Unneeded": return noChoice;
    case "Outnumbered": return {pass: false, title: "The deciding primary was closed to you",
      detail: `The race was decided in the ${winnerPrimary} primary, which you can't vote in.`};
    case "Excluded": return {pass: false, title: "The deciding primary was closed to you",
      detail: `The race was decided in the ${winnerPrimary} primary, which is closed to ${voterGroupNames[d.party]}.`};
    case "None-of-the-Above": return {pass: false, title: "Primaries closed to you",
      detail: `Iowa's two major party primaries are closed to ${voterGroupNames[d.party]}.`};
  }
}

function generalStep(d) {
  if (d.gen_margin_category === "Uncontested") {
    return {pass: false, title: "No race", detail: `${d.first_vote_cand} ran unopposed.`};
  }
  if (d.gen_competitive) {
    return {pass: true, title: "Competitive", detail: `Decided by ${percent(d.gen_margin)}, under the 10% line.`};
  }
  return {pass: false, title: "Not competitive", detail: `Decided by ${percent(d.gen_margin)}.`};
}

pathCard = (label, step) => htl.html`<div class="path-card ${step.pass ? "path-pass" : "path-fail"}">
  <div class="path-icon">
    ${icon(step.pass ? "check" : "xmark")}
    <span class="visually-hidden">${step.pass ? "Meaningful vote" : "No meaningful vote"}</span>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div class="path-label">${label}</div>
    <div class="path-title">${step.title}</div>
    <div class="path-detail">${step.detail}</div>
  </div>
</div>`
```

::: {#app_frame}

```{ojs}
// The inputs. Its value is {district, party} once "See my results" is
// pressed (or a URL gives both), and null while the inputs are showing.
viewof choice = {
  const form = htl.html`<form id="inputs" class="input-steps" novalidate>
    <div id="inputs_loading">
      <div class="spinner"></div>
      <p>Looking up your address...</p>
    </div>

    <div class="input-step">
      <h4><span class="step-num">1</span>Find your district</h4>
      <label class="form-label" for="address_input">Search for your address</label>
      <div class="address-search">
        <input id="address_input" class="form-control" type="search" autocomplete="street-address"
          placeholder="e.g. 1007 E Grand Ave, Des Moines">
        <button id="address_search" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" type="button" aria-label="Search">
          ${icon("search")}
        </button>
      </div>
      <small class="input-hint">Press Enter or click the search button.</small>
      <p id="search_warning" class="search-warning app-hidden">Address could not be found.</p>
      <p id="search_found" class="search-found app-hidden"></p>
      <div class="or-divider"><span>or choose from the list</span></div>
      <label class="form-label" for="legislator_input">Select your Iowa House representative</label>
      <select id="legislator_input" class="form-select" required>
        <option value="">Choose a representative</option>
        ${legislators.map(l => htl.html`<option value=${l.district_num}>${l.name} (${l.district_num})</option>`)}
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="input-step">
      <h4><span class="step-num">2</span>Your party registration</h4>
      <div id="party_input" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Your party registration">
        ${partyChoices.flatMap(([label, value]) => {
          // Separate elements, not one template: htl wraps a multi-element
          // template in a <span>, which would stop the buttons stretching
          const id = `party_${value.replace(" ", "_")}`;
          return [
            htl.html`<input type="radio" class="btn-check" name="party" id=${id} value=${value}>`,
            htl.html`<label class="btn btn-outline-primary" for=${id}>${label}</label>`
          ];
        })}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="submit-row">
      <button id="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" type="submit" disabled>See my results</button>
      <small id="submit_hint" class="input-hint">Choose a representative and a party to see your results.</small>
    </div>

    <p class="privacy-note">Addresses are looked up with Esri, or OpenStreetMap as a backup,
      straight from your browser. They aren't stored.</p>
  </form>`;

  const $ = id => form.querySelector(`#${id}`);
  const address = $("address_input"), legislator = $("legislator_input");
  const warning = $("search_warning"), found = $("search_found");
  const party = () => form.querySelector("input[name=party]:checked")?.value;

  // Submit is only clickable once a representative and a party are chosen;
  // until then a hint under the button says what's missing
  const updateSubmit = () => {
    const ready = Boolean(legislator.value && party());
    $("submit").disabled = !ready;
    $("submit_hint").classList.toggle("app-hidden", ready);
  };

  const setValue = value => {
    form.value = value;
    form.classList.toggle("app-hidden", value !== null);
    document.getElementById("app_frame").scrollTop = 0;
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };

  // Look up an address and choose its representative. The address stays in
  // the box with a confirmation under it.
  const search = async () => {
    const text = address.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    document.body.classList.add("geocoding");
    const lonLat = await geocode(text);
    const district = lonLat && findDistrict(lonLat);
    document.body.classList.remove("geocoding");
    warning.classList.toggle("app-hidden", Boolean(district));
    found.classList.toggle("app-hidden", !district);
    if (district) {
      legislator.value = district;
      found.replaceChildren(icon("circle-check"), ` Found District ${district}: ${legislatorLabel(district).replace(/ \(\d+\)$/, "")}`);
    }
    updateSubmit();
    return district;
  };

  $("address_search").addEventListener("click", search);
  address.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") { event.preventDefault(); search(); }
  });

  // Choosing a representative from the list replaces any address search
  legislator.addEventListener("change", () => {
    address.value = "";
    warning.classList.add("app-hidden");
    found.classList.add("app-hidden");
    updateSubmit();
  });
  form.querySelectorAll("input[name=party]").forEach(r => r.addEventListener("change", updateSubmit));

  form.addEventListener("submit", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (legislator.value && party()) setValue({district: +legislator.value, party: party()});
  });

  // Called by "Change my answers" in the results
  form.showInputs = () => setValue(null);

  // Fill the inputs from URL parameters, e.g. ?district=45&party=Dem or
  // ?address=1007 E Grand Ave Des Moines&party=Rep, and show the results right
  // away when both a district and a party are given
  // Waits a tick so the page is listening to the form before it's submitted
  form.value = null;
  setTimeout(async () => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const urlParty = partyLookup[(params.get("party") ?? "").toLowerCase()];
    if (urlParty) form.querySelector(`input[value="${urlParty}"]`).checked = true;

    let district = null;
    if (params.has("district")) {
      district = legislatorLabel(+params.get("district")) ? +params.get("district") : null;
      if (district) legislator.value = district;
    } else if (params.get("address")) {
      address.value = params.get("address");
      district = await search();
    }
    updateSubmit();
    if (district && urlParty) setValue({district, party: urlParty});
  });

  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
// The results, shown in place of the inputs once a choice is submitted
{
  if (!choice) return htl.html`<div></div>`;

  const d = districtRows.find(r => r.district_num === choice.district && r.party === choice.party);
  const typeText = voterTypeText.find(t => t.voter_classification === d.voter_classification);
  const gradeClass = `grade-${d.grade.toLowerCase().replace("+", "-plus")}`;
  const uncontested = d.gen_margin_category === "Uncontested";
  const electionText = uncontested
    ? `In November 2024, ${d.first_vote_cand} ran unopposed for your Iowa House seat.`
    : `In your Iowa House district's November 2024 election, ${d.first_vote_cand} won with a margin of ${percent(d.margin)}.`;

  const changeAnswers = htl.html`<a href="#" class="change-answers">${icon("arrow-left")} Change my answers</a>`;
  changeAnswers.addEventListener("click", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    viewof choice.showInputs();
  });

  return htl.html`<div id="results">
    ${changeAnswers}

    <div class="results-summary">
      <div class="results-headline">
        <div class="grade-badge ${gradeClass}" role="img" aria-label=${`Voter power grade: ${d.grade}`}>${d.grade}</div>
        <div>
          <div class="results-context">House District ${d.district_num} · ${partyNames[d.party]}</div>
          <h3>Your voter type is <span class="voter-type ${gradeClass}">${d.voter_classification}</span></h3>
          <div class="results-tagline">${typeText.summary_text}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p>${electionText}</p>
      <p class="results-explanation">${typeText.explanation_text}</p>
    </div>

    <div class="results-columns">
      <div class="vote-path">
        <div class="path-heading">Your two chances to make a difference</div>
        ${pathCard("Primary · June 2024", primaryStep(d))}
        <div class="path-arrow">${icon("arrow-down")}</div>
        ${pathCard("General · November 2024", generalStep(d))}
      </div>
      <div class="card dial-card">
        <div class="card-body">
          <div class="dial-title">How close was the general election?</div>
          ${marginDial(d.gen_margin, uncontested)}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>`;
}
```
